svg.title: Orbiter 8 intro, zoom: the block, all the way out
svg.text: 23:41 · Curfew: violence high, security response limited · Block 7 · Unit 7-2216
Scroll, pinch or the triggers zoom · the camera always comes back to you
1 · The block, all the way out.
The furthest the camera goes: the city, Block
7’s tower with your unit cut open, and you, a
speck with a yellow outline (ringed here). The
intro opens here and falls in.
From here everything is simple shapes: windows
are dots, the TV is a glow.
